reader.requirement: At 85, within one report group description entry (the 01 and its subordinates) the NEXT PAGE phrase may be written at most once and only in the first LINE NUMBER clause of the group; a NEXT PAGE in any later LINE clause (including a second one) must be refused, while separate report groups may each carry their own in their first clause.

a multiple LINE clause and the LINES/NUMBERS/ARE spellings refused below 2002 (COBOL0900, report-multi-line-2002)

reader.edition-search: The SR6 test (op.NEXT() && k == 0 && !firstLineClause, firstLineClause reset at each level-01 entry) consults no edition; the only edition switches reached are the two parse-arm gates on 2002 LINE forms.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the first-clause rule is the same code at every edition; at 85 a second operand in one LINE clause (where 2002 SR10a applies) is refused as a 2002 form.

reader.notes: The 'only once' half follows from the 'first clause' half: any second NEXT PAGE is in a later clause and is refused by the same test. The diagnostic cites §2023:13.18.35.3 SR7, the same sentence in the later edition.
